in_sanskrit.name: बालकृष्ण
in_sanskrit.meaning: बाल (bāla) - child, कृष्ण (kṛṣṇa) - dark, black, and God Krishna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bāla (child) and Kṛṣṇa (dark, black, and God Krishna) make the name Balkrushna. Bāla refers to the child form of Lord Krishna, while Kṛṣṇa symbolizes the divine and powerful aspect of the deity.

in_hindi.name: बालकृष्ण
in_hindi.meaning: बाल (बाला) - बच्चा (bacchā) - child, कृष्ण (कृष्णा) - कृष्ण (kṛṣṇa) - dark, black, and God Krishna
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bāla (बाला) or bacchā (बच्चा) refers to the child form of Lord Krishna, while Kṛṣṇa (कृष्ण) signifies the dark, black, and divine aspect of the deity.

in_tamil.name: பாலக்ருஷ்ண
in_tamil.meaning: பால (pāl) - child, க்ருஷ்ண (kruṣṇa) - dark, black, and God Krishna
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil name for Balkrushna is பாலக்ருஷ்ண (pālakruṣṇa). Here, பால (pāl) means child, and க்ருஷ்ண (kruṣṇa) refers to the dark, black, and divine aspect of Lord Krishna.

in_marathi.name: Balkrushna
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Balkrushna हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Balkrushna is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'Krushna' meaning black or dark. It is the name of Lord Vishnu, who is also known as Balaji or Balakrishna, symbolizing divine strength and protection.
